# Weblogr

> Weblogr is a Core PHP/MySQL publishing platform created as a Final Year Project and modernized as a portfolio-grade web application.

## Creator

Muhammad Talha — Software Engineer specializing in PHP, Laravel and full-stack web development.

- Portfolio: https://imiantalha.vercel.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/imiantalha
- Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/imiantalha
- Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~0129afd82850749f05?viewMode=1

## Project

Weblogr provides registration, profiles, publishing, drafts, categories, search, comments, likes, follows, notifications, reporting and administrator moderation.

## Technology

Core PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, MySQLi, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHPMailer and GitHub Actions.

## Indexing guidance

Only public, useful pages should be indexed. Authenticated application workflows, administration, database/configuration files and internal endpoints are intentionally excluded from crawling. Public posts can be added to the sitemap once the application exposes stable unauthenticated post URLs.
